column1: # The sampled groups of the TypeScript suite (scripts/test-group.cjs,
# ADR-070): group<TAB>file. Group 0 is the gate group the happy path
# runs on every push; the standard CI samples one of the others per
# run, and `npm test` runs every file regardless. A group is sized to
# finish in about two minutes on the hosted runner, so a file longer
# than that is split first (the shared-spec shares, the docs shards,
# the JSON Schema dialects). Every test file is in exactly one group,
